# changedetection_tag (Resource)

Create a changedetection.io Tag

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "changedetection_tag" "test" {
  title              = "test"
  notification_muted = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `title` (String) The tag's title.

### Optional

- `notification_muted` (Boolean) True if notifications are muted for this tag.

### Read-Only

- `date_created` (Number) The date at which the tag was created (seconds since Jan 1 1970).
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
